result.description: Work management platform for tasks, docs, goals, time tracking and team collaboration.
result.auth_detail: OAuth2 authorization-code for apps used by others (token currently non-expiring); personal API token (pk_...) in Authorization header for individual/testing use.
result.access_detail: Any ClickUp user can generate a personal token; a Workspace owner/admin creates OAuth apps in Settings > Apps with no review. API works on all plans including Free Forever (100 req/min per token; higher on paid plans).
result.api_notes: REST API v2 plus newer v3 endpoints, with an OpenAPI spec and llms.txt index. Covers tasks, lists, folders, spaces, comments, time tracking, docs, goals, webhooks, custom fields and more. I did not count endpoints exactly; the "broad" rating is a judgement from the doc index.

evidence.quote: Authenticate to the ClickUp API using a personal token or OAuth.
Only Workspace owners or admins can create OAuth apps.
Use a personal API token for individual or testing purposes. Personal tokens begin with `pk_`.
ClickUp API empowers you to create custom workflows, integrate seamlessly with your favorite tools, and scale your processes by mapping them directly to ClickUp.
[OpenAPI Specification](https://developer.clickup.com/docs/open-api-spec.md): Access and use the OpenAPI specification for the ClickUp API.
Authentication OAuth; API keys and personal access tokens aren’t supported
ClickUp API empowers you to create custom workflows, integrate seamlessly with your favorite tools, and scale your processes by mapping them directly to ClickUp.
For apps or integrations that other people use, use the [OAuth flow](https://developer.clickup.com/docs/authentication#oauth-flow), allowing users to authorize Workspaces for your app.
